title: Series Admission Is Not An Outcome
summary: An admission map separating observed records, compatible series, admitted cohorts, bounded outcomes, and comparative or causal claims.
map_question: What must be true before repeated observations can enter a cohort and support a bounded outcome?
interpretation_boundary: The map is an admission sequence, not a universal maturity ladder. A record can remain useful at its own node without advancing to a series, cohort, outcome, comparison, or causal claim.

nodes.label: Bounded observation
nodes.note: One same-entity record preserves source, scope, date, method, denominator, and exceptions.

nodes.label: Accepted recurrence
nodes.note: Multiple accepted operations preserve the same entity and operating scope.

nodes.label: Compatible series
nodes.note: Measure, denominator, period, method, revisions, breaks, and exceptions are compatible or reconciled.

nodes.label: Admitted cohort
nodes.note: Human review admits only the exact entity and measure contract; admission itself is not an outcome.

nodes.label: Bounded outcome
nodes.note: A compatible admitted series may support one scoped outcome with alternative explanations retained.

nodes.label: Comparison or causation
nodes.note: Cross-cohort comparison and causal attribution require separate designs and cannot inherit series admission.

nodes.label: Compatibility break
nodes.note: An unreconciled identity, scope, unit, denominator, period, method, revision, or exception change stops the series.

links.note: Repeated activity is not a series until its measurement contract is compatible.
A passing compatibility test becomes eligible for human admission review only.
No Phase 68 cohort is admitted and no bounded outcome is created.
A bounded outcome does not establish cross-cohort comparability or causation.
Any unreconciled break keeps the candidate in acquisition.

what_this_map_supports: Eight inspectable compatibility dimensions before cohort admission.
Entity-specific measure contracts with empty values until qualified evidence returns.
Visible acquisition and break states instead of manufactured trends.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that a qualifying series exists.
It does not create an outcome, benchmark, forecast, score, or rank.
It does not support cross-entity comparison or causal attribution.
next_records_needed: Multi-period measures with stable or reconciled denominators, methods, revisions, and exceptions.
Independent admission decisions and bounded receipts with complete propagation.
